capabilities: Render inline %% comments %% as margin review cards in reading, Live Preview, and Source mode
Insert, reply to, edit, delete, and resolve comment threads
Quote a selected passage into a new comment
Mention an AI agent in a comment to have it respond and act in the thread
Show thread counts in the status bar and mark notes with threads in the file explorer
disambiguation: Not a real-time collaboration tool; comments live in the note's Markdown and are answered later by readers or an agent.
extras: Agent mention execution requires desktop; comment viewing and editing also work on mobile. Minimum Obsidian version 1.13.0. The plugin has no telemetry or external comment service; author names are stored per device, and setting a Gravatar email sends a hashed email to Gravatar.
intentEvidence: Inline Review Comments turns Obsidian's %% comments %% into review cards in the right margin
problem: Obsidian's inline %% comments %% are hidden markers with no visible interface, so leaving feedback beside a passage or exchanging replies with an agent or collaborator is awkward.

relations.evidence: With the AI Overview plugin enabled on desktop, set Settings → AI Overview → Agent name tag
The plugin sends a SHA-256 hash of the email to Gravatar over HTTPS

requires.name: an AI agent with read/edit access to the notes

summary: Margin review-card interface for Obsidian inline %% comments %% where humans and AI agents exchange threaded feedback stored in the note's Markdown.
